categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Hechuan Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in industrial automation, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of core industrial automation components and integrated solutions. Its main products include servo systems, programmable logic controllers (PLC), machine tools, chips, sensors, touch screens, frequency converters, industrial motors, direct drive motors, and precision linear guides and screws. The company serves diverse industries such as photovoltaics, lithium batteries, robotics, laser, 3C electronics, packaging, textile, logistics, and woodworking.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including servo control, PLC control, embedded systems, high-precision encoder technology, intelligent adjustment algorithms, high-speed bus control, and integrated drive-control SIP chips. It has established multiple R&D centers and employs a matrix R&D management model integrating product development and resource support. Manufacturing involves deep vertical integration with in-house casting, CNC precision machining, electronic component placement, and automated assembly lines, enabling flexible production and high-quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are mainly from the new energy sector, including photovoltaic and lithium battery industries, as well as robotics, 3C electronics, laser processing, packaging, textile, logistics, and machine tool sectors. Major clients include industry leaders such as BYD, CATL, Foxconn Industrial Internet, SF Express, and Longi. The company focuses on large terminal customers and provides tailored turnkey solutions for over 20 specialized industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Zhejiang Province and multiple subsidiaries across Chinese cities including Hangzhou, Suzhou, Dalian, and Quzhou. It also has international subsidiaries in Singapore and Germany. The company is actively expanding its overseas presence, targeting markets such as India, Turkey, Russia, and Southeast Asia, and participates in international exhibitions to enhance global brand influence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hechuan Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the industrial automation supply chain. It designs and manufactures core components such as servo systems, PLCs, chips, and sensors, and integrates these into complete automation solutions. The company also extends upstream by developing industrial control chips and downstream by producing high-end precision machine tools and integrated systems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in industrial automation, focusing on enhancing servo and PLC technologies, developing new products like frequency converters, sensors, industrial motors, and direct drive motors, and expanding digital factory solutions. It emphasizes deep industry customization, integration of AI and robotics, and digital transformation. R&D efforts include 42 ongoing projects, significant patent holdings, and continuous investment in advanced testing labs and product lifecycle management systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of industrial automation products including servo systems, PLCs, machine tools, and chips. The company employs a mixed sales model with a majority through distributors and direct sales to strategic customers. It also earns income from related services such as technical support and integrated solution delivery. Additionally, the company manages financial assets and investments contributing to non-operating income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hechuan Technology is positioned as a leading domestic industrial automation supplier with competitive products that rival international brands like Siemens, Yaskawa, and Mitsubishi. It holds approximately 4.4% market share in the domestic general servo system market, ranking second among Chinese brands. The company competes by leveraging high-performance, cost-effective products and localized service, gradually increasing its market share against dominant foreign players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 810.7 million, a 27.4% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 165 million. Total assets stood at about RMB 1.97 billion with equity of RMB 1.31 billion. Despite recent revenue declines due to market saturation in photovoltaics, the company continues to invest heavily in R&D (about 19.85% of revenue) and expands its product portfolio and market reach, aiming for sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hechuan Technology emphasizes high performance, reliability, cost-effectiveness, and industrial-grade design in its products. It offers a comprehensive product matrix covering control, drive, execution, and sensing layers, enabling one-stop automation solutions tailored to diverse industry needs. The company’s proprietary technologies, such as high-precision encoders and integrated SIP chips, provide competitive advantages in precision, stability, and integration. Its deep manufacturing capabilities and localized customer service further differentiate it from competitors.
